purpose: Teach: 突撃/下半身/名言/セレブ/鍼/歌舞伎町/ベッカム/旅人

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが戦時中の突撃の歴史番組をご覧になったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father was watching a history programme about wartime cavalry charges.
lines.style: Gentle, dreamy quality. Soft opening. Speaking as if sharing something quietly observed, almost to herself. Warm cadence, no urgency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、下半身の筋トレ始めたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I started training my lower body at the gym!
lines.style: Bright, direct announcement. Quick attack on the opening. Genuine pride underneath — he's telling her something that matters to him. Eager but not frantic.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが偉人の名言を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father was sharing quotes from great people with me.
lines.style: Soft, contemplative. Gentle lean into the memory. Speaking as though she's still thinking about what he said. Unhurried, warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、セレブの写真を雑誌で見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw photos of celebrities in a magazine the other day!
lines.style: Quick, excited delivery. Bright energy. He wants to share something he finds interesting. Open, guileless tone — no filter, just genuine enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが鍼灸の本を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father was reading a book about acupuncture and moxibustion.
lines.style: Peaceful, observant tone. Slight wonder underneath — noticing the specificity of what he's interested in. Slow, appreciative pace. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、歌舞伎町は子供は行けないって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard that kids aren't allowed to go to Kabuki-cho, is that true?
lines.style: Curious, questioning lilt at the end. Open and genuinely wondering — he's processing something he learned. Natural, unguarded cadence. Seeking reassurance or explanation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがベッカム選手のサインカードを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father gave me a Beckham signed card.
lines.style: Soft wonder and gentle pleasure. Opening note like she's still holding the moment. Quiet delight — as if she's telling Sho something precious. Warm finality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、世界中を旅人みたいに回りたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to travel around the whole world like a wanderer!
lines.style: Bright, open-hearted declaration. Dream-forward quality. Animated but not hyperactive — the earnestness of a child imagining something big. Trailing upward slightly, inviting her into the vision.
